theorem lg_target : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) fun x => √x := by
  intro x y hxy c hc
  have h : 0 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ y := by split; intro a; apply Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 a
  let hx := h.1
  let hy := h.2
  let cx := c x
  let cy := c y
  let k := (x + y) / 2
  let hk : 0 ≤ k := by rw [add_div_eq]; exact add_nonneg hx hy
  let hk' : k ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by apply Set.Ici.mem_iff.2 hk
  let hkc : c k = √k := by rw [Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 hk']
  let hcx : cx = √x := by rw [Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 hx]
  let hcy : cy = √y := by rw [Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 hy]
  have h1 : (√x + √y) / 2 > √k :=
    by cases hxy with hxy1 hxy2;
       have h2 : 0 < x ∨ 0 < y := or.intro_left (by exact False.elim (le_zero_iff_zero_eq.1 hx)) (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_rfl) (ne_of_gt (by exact lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ))))
       cases h2 with h2a h2b;
       case h2a { -- 0 < x
         have h3 : (√x + √y) / 2 > √k :=
           by have h4 : (√x + √y)^2 > 4 * k :=
              by rw [add_mul, add_mul, mul_add, mul_add];
                 have h5 : x + 2 * √(x * y) + y > 4 * k :=
                   by rw [add_add, add_add, add_add];
                      have h6 : x + y > 2 * k :=
                        by rw [add_div_eq];
                           have h7 : x + y > 2 * (x + y) / 2 :=
                             by rw [mul_two];
                                have h8 : (x + y) / 2 = k := rfl;
                                have h9 : 2 * k = x + y := rfl;
                                have h10 : x + y > 2 * k :=
                                  by rw [h9]; have h11 : x + y > x + y := by exact lt_irrefl (x + y); contradiction
                      have h12 : 4 * k = 2 * (2 * k) := rfl
